hero.title: The first layer of the teaching management admin architecture is in place
hero.description: Based on the admin prototype, the portal is now split into a unified sidebar, top identity area, homepage overview, and teaching management sub-routes. You can continue building real business pages on top of this structure instead of starting from scattered entry points.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Stabilize the extensible admin shell first, then fill in filters, tables, and dialogs.

highlights.title: Architecture Highlights
highlights.description: These are not marketing bullets. They are the parts that actually make follow-up development easier.

architecture.title: Unified information architecture
architecture.description: Sidebar entries, homepage cards, and child pages are all driven by one config source, avoiding mismatches when modules are added later.

domains.title: Domain-based expansion
domains.description: Teaching management is separated under `/admin/teaching/*` first, while base data, content, and AI applications can be added in parallel later.

placeholders.title: Delivery-oriented placeholders
placeholders.description: Each teaching module already has an accessible entry page ready to receive filters, tables, dialogs, and API integration.

modules.title: Teaching Management Modules
modules.description: All 8 core modules are already available under `/admin/teaching/*`, so each entry can now evolve into a real page with forms and tables.

majors.title: Major Management
majors.description: Manage school majors and their relationships with courses.

grades.title: Grade Management
grades.description: Maintain grade structures with custom naming and deletion rules.

classes.title: Class Management
classes.description: Maintain class information, generated codes, and links to majors and grades.

semesters.title: Semester Management
semesters.description: Set semester ranges, current semester markers, and active status.

students.title: Student Management
students.description: Manage student records with batch import and student ID rules.

teachers.title: Teacher Management
teachers.description: Manage teacher records, employee code rules, and teaching relations.

courses.title: Course Management
courses.description: Manage course information, categories, credits, and major applicability.

tasks.title: Teaching Task Management
tasks.description: Assign teaching tasks across teachers, courses, classes, and semesters.
